description: This source file implements functions related to notes caching within a Git repository, including initialization, reading, writing, and managing note entries in the cache.

methods.name: int notes_cache_match_validity(struct repository * r,const char * ref,const char * validity)
methods.description: Checks if the validity of a notes cache matches the expected validity string by reading a specific reference and commit message.

methods.name: void notes_cache_init(struct repository * r,struct notes_cache * c,const char * name,const char * validity)
methods.description: Initializes a notes cache structure, setting up the reference and validity, and possibly creating an empty cache.

methods.name: int notes_cache_write(struct notes_cache * c)
methods.description: Writes the current state of the notes cache to the repository by creating and updating the relevant references and commit object.

methods.name: char * notes_cache_get(struct notes_cache * c,struct object_id * key_oid,size_t * outsize)
methods.description: Retrieves the note data associated with a specific object ID from the cache.

methods.name: int notes_cache_put(struct notes_cache * c,struct object_id * key_oid,const char * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Adds a new note to the cache associated with a specific object ID.
